crossRefs.note: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”
Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said…
“Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.
For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against…
Do you think that I have come to give peace in the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.
But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.
for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and…
For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe…

translations.web: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.
translations.bsb: Again there was division among the Jews because of Jesus’ message.
translations.kjv: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.
translations.asv: There arose a division again among the Jews because of these words.
